explanation: The woman described in Song of Solomon, loved by the man and often compared to beautiful elements from nature.
The man described in Song of Solomon, who loves the woman and is often referred to as king or shepherd.
A deep feeling of devotion, passion, and care between two people, here used to describe the relationship between the bride and groom.
A symbol of beauty and fruitfulness, often used in Song of Solomon to describe the bride and her body.
A fruit that symbolizes fruitfulness and love, mentioned several times in Song of Solomon.
An affectionate and respectful expression used by the groom to refer to the bride, indicating their close bond and relationship.
The king of Israel who has traditionally been credited with authorship of Song of Solomon, although it is uncertain whether he actually wrote it.
